question: does replacing the averaged-pooled read key with the growth design's localized+centered encoding let the written faces keep their carrier while the three negative classes fall behind a single shared threshold?
sequence: build the real-forward store with today's mean-pooled keys (arm A)
rebuild the same store's addresses with localized_centered, centroid fit once from its own 30 keys (arm B); values/ages/count are reused byte-identically
154 queries per arm: 22 written read wordings, 66 unwritten wordings, 22 new_token, 22 new_pairing, 22 no_value midpoints of that arm's stored keys
gate anchored on each arm's own written floor; pass rule C6 evaluated once

criteria.C1_control_identity: for each arm the runner's own cosine read reproduces the real addressed_read with the same injected key on all 154 queries: identical fast sha, identical top slot, max|delta| = 0
criteria.C2_one_encoding: write and read use the same encoder in an arm; arm B never reuses an arm-A key; the encoding changes only when the store is rebuilt at the session boundary
criteria.C3_centroid_rule: the centroid is the mean of the occupied keys of that same arm-B store, fit once before any reading; tau=0.5 and top_k=4 come from the growth spec, not from a search
criteria.C4_values_unchanged: store values, ages and count are byte-identical between arm A and arm B: only the address changes, so any difference is attributable to the encoder
criteria.C5_threshold_source: the gate threshold is the minimum top cosine of the written group in that same arm; no negative label enters the value
criteria.C6_pass: pass = written floor >= 0.90 AND at least two of the three gaps > 0 AND the count of the 22 written faces found by their own read wording is not lower than arm A
criteria.V1_pass: if C6 holds the verdict is localized_centered_enables_gate with the threshold interval
criteria.V2_fail: otherwise the verdict is encoder_also_insufficient: this content-addressed write + read gate line is closed, no further encoding, geometry or threshold tuning
criteria.unchanged: no fixture, face, position, class, tau, top_k or anchor is retuned after first reading
